senses.gloss: (b. h. אֱדֹם) pr. n. m. Edom, surname of Esau, son of Isaac; mostly used as a nom. gentil. Edomite, Edomite nation
fem. (sub. מלכות) Rome, Roman government (owing to the dependence of Herod on Rome).
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 35:5">Ex. R. s. 35</cite>; a. fr.
Ibid. מלכות א׳; a. fr. [In subsequent ages: Christianity.]
